scope: Shared placement-aware typed frontend and inspectable IR, mandatory before Metal source artifact publication; explicit constant tensor shape literals.

semantics.selectors: Exact uint32 GPU identity and CPU selectors; immutable aliases; hardware-independent checking.
semantics.operations: Typed DeviceSelection, Transfer and explicit/implicit spawn targets; argument evaluation before target selection.
semantics.residency: Explicit transfers required across host/device boundaries; scalar results stay host; branches agree on residence.
semantics.ownership: Existing structured task/error obligations, await/try/catch/match settlement and immutable buffer ownership retained.
semantics.shapes: CPU calls expose declared ABI shape contracts. Unknown fixed-shape constraints on spawned calls remain child obligations.
semantics.constructors: Flat literal data and constant dimensions reuse TensorLiteral lowering; checked ranks, element counts, indexing/allocation and row-major stride overflow.
semantics.backend_guard: CPU lowering rejects placement-bearing IR; default CPU checker policy remains intact.
semantics.integration: Metal compiler checks whole source with shared frontend and writes placement.ir. Existing supervisor emitter still walks source syntax; IR-driven continuation lowering is next.

qualification.compiler_asan_ubsan: Sanitized compiler produced nested-parallel placement IR identical to normal compiler.

distributed_execution: Not implemented; design-review gate retained in docs/roadmap.md.
performance: Frontend correctness and integration; no speedup claim.
